product_metadata.title: KitchenAid KSMPCA Pasta Cutter Attachment Set (2 Piece), One Size, Silver
features: Powered by your KitchenAid Stand Mixer* to make quick and easy work of fresh homemade pasta in your kitchen using the 3-Piece Pasta Roller & Cutter Set; fits all Household KitchenAid Stand Mixers, *sold separately.
Stainless steel cutters for consistent and clean cutting of pasta dough
Use the spaghetti cutter attachment to cut pasta sheets into wide ribbon noodles
Use the fettuccine cutter attachment to cut pasta sheets into thin, angel hair noodles
Model KSMPCA includes (1) lasagnette cutter, (1) capellini cutter, (1) cleaning brush
description: Powered by the KitchenAid Stand Mixer, the 2-Piece Pasta Cutter Set makes fresh pasta from scratch quickly & easily. Includes Capellini and Lasagnette Cutters. For everything you want to make. KitchenAid.

details.Included Components: Angel Hair Cutter, Thick Noodle Cutter
